summary.text: Robby Carter is a Democratic member of the Louisiana House of Representatives, representing District 72 (St. Helena and Tangipahoa parishes), and was elected in 2015, according to the official House member page. Robby Carter chairs the Judiciary Committee.

paragraphs.text: The member page lists Robby Carter's occupation as Attorney.
It lists education as B.A., Southeastern Louisiana University; J.D., Louisiana State University.

The page lists committee assignments including Judiciary (chair), and caucus affiliations including the Capital Region Legislative Delegation, the Louisiana Rural Caucus and the Northshore Delegation.
